name: ASUS RT-AX86U Pro
notes: This support-only entry covers ASUS RT-AX86U Pro (RT-AX86U Pro). It summarizes the ASUS stock firmware and AsusWrt-Merlin support listed for this model. No firmware was flashed.

ownership.label: AsusWrt-Merlin community firmware
ownership.details: AsusWrt-Merlin stable 3006.102.9_0 (2026-09-23) is listed for RT-AX86U Pro.

supportRoutes.name: AsusWrt-Merlin
supportRoutes.description: AsusWrt-Merlin stable 3006.102.9_0 (2026-09-23) is listed for RT-AX86U Pro.
requirements: Upload the model-matched image through the ASUS firmware upgrade page in the router web UI.
Reboot the router before flashing; low memory may cause an image rejection.
On ASUS stock 3.0.0.6.102_37000 or newer, the first Merlin flash may need the documented downgrade check over SSH.

supportRoutes.name: ASUS stock firmware
supportRoutes.description: ASUS lists 3.0.0.6.102_37544 dated 2026-10-22 for RT-AX86U Pro on its model support page.
requirements: Match RT-AX86U Pro exactly and check the model support page before downloading.
ASUS demonstrates Firmware Restoration separately as its rescue-mode route.

supportRoutes.name: Firmware Restoration
supportRoutes.description: ASUS documents Firmware Restoration for rescue mode. Its FAQ demonstrates the procedure on an RT-AC68U, so its LED timing is not confirmed for this model.
requirements: Unzip the stock firmware before using the utility; it cannot upload an archive.
Use a wired PC with the documented static IP, enter rescue mode by holding Reset while powering on, then restore the stock image.

hardware.note: ASUS does not name the SoC on the spec page.
